charity.description: SpecialEffect is a UK Charity that puts fun and inclusion back into the lives of people with physical disabilities by helping them to play video games. Using technology ranging from modified controllers to eye-control, they find a way for people of all ages to play to the best of their abilities. They do not charge for their services, so your donation, large or small, really does count.
charity.name: SpecialEffect
